in_sanskrit.name: सिषुद्यम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sisodiya is derived from the Sanskrit words 'siṣu' meaning 'young' and 'udyam' meaning 'brave' or 'valiant'. This name is believed to have originated from the Sisodia Rajput clan.

in_hindi.name: सिसोदिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sisodiya in Hindi translates to 'bada vīr', which means 'great hero' or 'strong warrior'. This name is of Rajasthani origin and is believed to have derived from the Sisodia Rajput clan.

in_tamil.name: சிசோடியா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Sisodiya in Tamil translates to 'viralkkuṛīya siṟappu', which means 'brave and young one'. This name is of Rajasthani origin and is believed to have derived from the Sisodia Rajput clan.

in_telugu.name: శిశోదియ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Sisodiya in Telugu translates to 'dēśikī pēripōḍḍu', which means 'one who possesses the kingdom'. This name is of Rajasthani origin and is believed to have derived from the Sisodia Rajput clan.

in_marathi.name: Sisodiya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lady of the Fort
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sisodiya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of the Fortress, Princess
